commentary.text: 90+10' Frank Willenborg is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
90+7' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90+6' Substitution. Antonio Nusa did his best and is replaced by Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig).
90+4' Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Lukas Kwasniok prepares a substitution. Jan Thielmann is replaced by Felipe Chavez (1. FC Koln).
90' Lukas Kwasniok is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ragnar Ache suffers an injury and Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln) comes on.
88' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) picks up an injury.
87' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle as Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
85' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is caught offside!
84' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

84' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
82' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for FC Koln! Play can continue.
82' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) replaces Yan Diomande.
82' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) replacing Brajan Gruda.
80' Referee Frank Willenborg makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for FC Koln. Let’s see what happens!
78' Kristoffer Lund goes off the pitch and Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) comes on.
76' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
76' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
76' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

75' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off a brilliant save.
73' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) makes a strong challenge and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
71' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
69' He should have scored! Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
68' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Isak Johannesson will be replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
66' A cross into the box from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared.

64' It will be a substitution. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) is ready to enter the pitch as Romulo Cardoso walks off.
63' David Raum (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
61' 39:61 – the latest ball possession ratio.
60' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
58' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' 1 - 2 Goal! Xaver Schlager provides Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
56' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig).
52' Ole Werner (RB Leipzig) gets a yellow card, off the field.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 1:1.
49' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Dangerous play by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig). Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
39' The foul by Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) was seen by Frank Willenborg who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
35' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
34' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) will take the corner.
33' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
32' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

29' 0 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick!David Raum sends a cross in and Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes low into the middle of the net and the score changes to 0:1.
29' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) trips an opposition player and Frank Willenborg signals a foul.
28' FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

26' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
26' RB Leipzig quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

25' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Close! Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. FC Koln are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
15' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Frank Willenborg who sees an offensive foul.
13' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.

4' Excellent touch by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
